doubts.claim: Weight 11 was selected objectively for fleet throughput rather than single-run latency.
doubts.counterexample: A replay using only dominant units or intuitive constants could falsely favor concurrency.
doubts.evidence_needed: All unit durations across repeated canonical runs, reproducible candidate calculations, queue metrics, and real sibling lease overlap.
doubts.disposition: The evidence retains 54 unit durations across three canonical audits. Independent recomputation reproduced every 8/11/22 makespan. Weight 11 yields 25.81 runs/hour with two 11-of-22 grants; synchronized sibling-worktree tests prove compatible grants overlap without exceeding capacity.

doubts.claim: The two recorded race shapes were diagnosed rather than hidden by clean reruns.
doubts.counterexample: Removing parallelism or timing assertions after an intermittent failure could merely hide the signal.
doubts.evidence_needed: Controlled outer-load reproduction, isolated controls, explicit scheduling gates, planted regressions, and repeated canonical results.
doubts.disposition: Integration reproduced 17 nested-fanout failures and passed 468/468 alone with xdist; it is now serial internally. Lease ordering uses explicit gates, both planted mutations turn red, and three canonical audits are green.

doubts.claim: Strict gate and process-lifecycle semantics remain intact.
doubts.counterexample: Bounded output, retries, or cancellation could change classification, coverage, process cleanup, or lock reuse.
doubts.evidence_needed: JUnit-only classification, retry shape tests, native descendant cleanup, rejected coverage cleanup, real lock unwind, immediate reuse, one-root and CI parity.
doubts.disposition: The complete tools-root proof covers all listed boundaries; 467 tests pass with 15 skipped and 2 deselected. Native Windows topology, integrated lock unwind, immediate reuse, one-root and CI parity remain covered.

doubts.claim: Cancellation is distinguished from a natural child exit 130 and every retry lifecycle terminates visibly.
doubts.counterexample: A natural retry rc130 was previously raised as KeyboardInterrupt, while a real cancelled retry omitted its completion record.
doubts.evidence_needed: Structured cancellation state and opposing regressions.
doubts.disposition: An explicit cancelled boolean controls interruption. Natural rc130 remains red infrastructure; actual cancellation retains evidence, emits complete outcome=cancelled, then interrupts.

doubts.claim: Diagnostic evidence is bounded, redacted, durable, and linked without leaking output.
doubts.counterexample: Metadata secrets, a disposable worktree path, or missing card wiring could invalidate the claim.
doubts.evidence_needed: All-field redaction, linked-worktree survival, atomic bounded storage, and tracked-card round trip.
doubts.disposition: All untrusted fields are redacted; evidence writes to the canonical main-root ignored run store; a real linked worktree proves survival; the card persists evidencePath and excludes captured output.

doubts.claim: The durable store preserves standalone F0 and the evidence map is honest.
doubts.counterexample: The first resolver import broke the isolated CLI and F0.5 was credited with tests outside its artifact.
doubts.evidence_needed: Exact isolated CLI execution and accurate verification assignment.
doubts.disposition: Package-relative imports plus the complete fixture closure pass the exact CLI E2E. The spec now assigns only host CLI to F0.5 and cleanup/reuse to the canonical tools root.
